latest_release.name: v1.17.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

A patch release with fixes for rules that reused configuration across runs and for false positives/negatives.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> `add-constant` now inspects nested call arguments and function literal signatures (#1843), so existing projects may see new findings after upgrading.

### Bug Fixes
* `add-constant`: inspect nested arguments by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1843
* `add-constant`: reset configuration by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1839
* `banned-characters`: reset configuration by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1851
* `enforce-switch-style`: reset configuration by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1849
* `file-header`: reset configuration by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1853
* `file-length-limit`: reset configuration by @AdamMagued in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1856
* `import-alias-naming`: reset configuration by @AdamMagued in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1859
* `string-format`: reset configuration by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1833
* `struct-tag`: reset configuration by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1841
* `unhandled-error`: reset configuration by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1837
* `var-naming`: reset configuration by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1845
* Reset configuration in `Configure` by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1889
* `enforce-repeated-arg-type-style`: fix error message by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1880
* `function-length`: continue after empty function by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1827
* `max-public-structs`: count only structs by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1829
* `max-public-structs`: do not count Unicode names by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1878
* `struct-tag`: track tag numbers per tag key by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1887
* `unnecessary-format`: handle escaped percent by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1884
* `unnecessary-if`: handle same branch values by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1883
* `unnecessary-stmt`: ignore switch with only default by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1885
* Escape all regexp metacharacters in literal file filters by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1886
* Include all configured SARIF rules by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1823

### Documentation
* Migrate repo to revive-lint organization by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1806
* Add "Revive version" to "Available Rules" table by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1807
* Add revive version to rules descriptions by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1808
* Update sections in release policy by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1805

### Dependency Updates
* Update `github.com/revive-lint/dots` to v1.1.0 by @alexandear in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1882

## New Contributors
* @dajiaohuang made their first contribution in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1827
* @AdamMagued made their first contribution in https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/pull/1856

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/revive-lint/revive/compare/v1.17.0...v1.17.1
